description: Diagnose common A2A JSON-RPC SendMessage version and message-shape mistakes. Use when debugging an A2A integration. Send a sanitized request example and selected protocol version, never secrets or headers. Returns fixed field corrections and an authored template. Does not contact an endpoint or certify full conformance.

protocolVersion.description: Target A2A version from the server's Agent Card, NOT the MCP transport date.

request.description: Sanitized A2A JSON-RPC body to inspect, not a URL, string or HTTP wrapper. Malformed message fields are allowed for diagnosis. Never include secrets, headers or private content. Entire arguments JSON: at most 16384 ASCII-escaped UTF-8 bytes.

name: diagnose_a2a_request
